status: PARTIAL: monitor micro-benchmark only. Idle, normal, peak, spike and soak baselines of the real application are NOT VERIFIED.
why: The application baselines need the API plus Postgres and Redis under a load generator in an isolated environment, and no load tool exists in the repo. None was run.

environment.commit: 604c1db95bac5efb2245506552f95f4801b63461 (base; the working tree already contained this change when measured)
environment.cpu: Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 7 155H, 22 logical cores, 31.4 GB
environment.infrastructureProfile: developer laptop, load generator and server on the same machine
environment.loadGenerator: tools/event-loop-audit/bench.mjs, in-process node:http keep-alive, closed loop, 32 concurrent
environment.service: bench server with the real RuntimeMonitor (1 s window to speed the run)
environment.duration: 3 rounds x 10 s per condition, plus 10 s fault run and 4 s recovery run

comparabilityWarning: Valid only against runs from this same machine and Node version. Do not compare with CI or production numbers.

monitorOverhead.reading: The -1.7% is inside the round-to-round spread of the monitor-off runs themselves (2307 to 2970 rps). Overhead is not distinguishable from noise at this sample size. This is NOT proof that overhead is zero.

detectionUnderFault.injected: 4 synchronous 300 ms blocks, 2 s apart, under 32-way load
detectionUnderFault.reading: Each block was visible as a critical window and as request max near the block length.

recovery.reading: Latency and loop delay returned to the pre-fault level within the next window.

notVerified: per-module (contacts, inbox, webhook, broadcast, automation) baselines
